label: A lever lethal before the scoring stage cannot produce the phenotype
statement_en: death_hpf <= scored_hpf implies the phenotype cannot be scored in a living animal.

hypotheses.name: Delphi.Empirical.CanScore
hypotheses.statement: death_hpf <= scored_hpf implies the phenotype cannot be scored in a living animal.

evaluated.quote: LETHAL: 'die around 2 days post fertilization' / 'They die at 48 hpf'. The animal dies at the same stage at which the fin phenotype is scored, before any fin skeletal differentiation.

LETHAL BEFORE THE RAY PARAMETER EXISTS: 'The mutants fail to develop swim bladders and die by approximately 12 dpf.' Lepidotrichia are not formed by then, so no ray length, segment or branching value can be measured in this allele, and the effect_size value is null for that reason. Even fully rescued mutants 'did not survive to adulthood'.
evaluated.conversion: death "by approximately 12 dpf" = 288 h; the ray parameters exist only from Juvenile:Days 45-89, taken as 45 dpf = 1080 h

notEvaluated.why: the genotype thread records lethality as free text (58 rows say "not reported"); only rows that state BOTH a time of death and a scoring stage in hours are instantiated here, and no time is parsed out of prose beyond those two

hypotheses.source: genotype/interventions.json (the genotype thread's own lethality notes, quoted in the value)
hypotheses.observation: Two levers in the project's own intervention table state both times: ezh2 dies at 48 hpf, the stage at which its fin absence is scored, and wls dies by 12 dpf while the ray parameters exist only from 45 dpf.

scope.basis: genotype/interventions.json: zebrafish alleles and treatments, death and scoring stages in hours post fertilisation
scope.note: Only the 2 rows that state both a death time and a scoring stage in hours are instantiated. the genotype thread records lethality as free text (58 rows say "not reported"); only rows that state BOTH a time of death and a scoring stage in hours are instantiated here, and no time is parsed out of prose beyond those two Lethality of a homozygote says nothing about a heterozygote, a mosaic, a conditional allele or a rescue, and a lever lethal in zebrafish may not be in another species.
